statistics.unit: cyber attacks per organization per day
statistics.scope: Per organization in Check Point’s observed dataset
statistics.source_title: Check Point Research — July 2026 threat landscape
statistics.evidence_quote: Organizations faced an average of 2,336 weekly cyber attacks, up 3% from June and 16% from July 2025.
statistics.interpretation: Daily average derived from the published weekly average, not successful breaches or a prediction for an individual organization.

statistics.source_title: APWG — Phishing Activity Trends, Q2 2026, pages 2–3
statistics.evidence_quote: There were 425,808 attacks recorded in June 2026, which was the highest monthly total since April 2023, when APWG tallied 597,789 attacks.
statistics.interpretation: Daily average equivalent of unique phishing sites reported in June; APWG uses sites as its attack measure. Not victims, phishing-message volume, or a census of all social engineering.

methodology: Historical source-scoped averages, not a live counter. Different populations and counting methods; not added together. Phishing represents a form of social engineering, not the whole category. These figures are industry context, not Kyber results or a forecast for a prospect.
